title: AI Context Purifier
description: Clean Markdown from any webpage selection for ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools. Strip cookie banners, nav bars, and page noise with one shortcut.
longDescription: Select content on any webpage, press a shortcut, and copy purified Markdown instead of dragging UI junk into your prompts.
heroTagline:
Stop pasting nav bars and cookie banners into your prompts.
⌘ Shift X — select text on any webpage,
get clean Markdown. Ready for ChatGPT, Claude, or any AI.
mockupSubtitle: Select text on any page, press ⌘ Shift X. The toast confirms. Your clipboard has clean Markdown.
featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to feed clean context into any language model.

features.title: INSTANT SHORTCUT
features.desc: Use ⌘ Shift X on Mac or Ctrl Shift X on Windows on any website. Customizable via chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

features.title: RIGHT-CLICK MENU
features.desc: Select text, right-click, and copy as clean Markdown when you do not want to rely on the keyboard shortcut.

features.title: SURGICAL EXTRACTION
features.desc: Purifies only the selected content instead of converting the whole page like reader modes do.

features.title: CLEAN MARKDOWN
features.desc: Preserves headings, emphasis, code, and links while removing interface noise and layout junk.

features.title: COPY HISTORY
features.desc: Save the last 10 purified texts locally and re-copy them from the popup with one click. Pro only.

features.title: CUSTOM FILTERS
features.desc: Add site-specific CSS selectors for noise the default filter set does not catch. Pro only.

themesSubtitle: Use the shortcut for speed, the context menu for precision, and Pro filters when you need site-specific cleanup.

steps.title: INSTALL
steps.desc: Add AI Context Purifier from the Chrome Web Store. No signup, no account, no config required.

steps.title: SELECT
steps.desc: Mark any text on any webpage, from articles and docs to Stack Overflow threads and GitHub READMEs.

steps.title: PURIFY
steps.desc: Press ⌘ Shift X or use the context menu to copy clean Markdown directly into your AI workflow.

pricingSubtitle: The core feature is free forever. Pay once for history and custom filters.
